metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Goes back to practice squad
metadata.description: Mullens did not play during Sunday's 20-13 loss at Denver.
metadata.analysis: Mullens would have been the next man up after starter Trevor Lawrence with Quinn Evers inactive, but the Jaguars didn't have to call his number in Week 2. Jacksonville can elevate him once more this year before he'd need to be signed to their 53-man roster to be eligible to play.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Elevated to active roster once again
metadata.description: The Jaguars elevated Mullens to the active roster from the practice squad Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Mullens was elevated for the Jaguars' Week 1 win over the Browns last Sunday. The quarterback took seven offensive snaps for the team in the fourth quarter, once the game was all but over. The 31-year-old veteran is set to play the backup role to Trevor Lawrence again and should only enter the game if Lawrence goes down or the team gets to garbage time.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Reverts to Jacksonville's practice squad
metadata.description: Mullens reverted to the Jaguars' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Mullens played in seven offensive snaps for the Jaguars after the 34-10 blowout win over the Browns was out of reach. With Quinn Ewers (coach's decision) inactive, Liam Cohen granted Mullens the victorious clock-burning stat line of three carries for a loss of three yards.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Elevated for Week 1
metadata.description: The Jaguars elevated Mullens from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Mullens will likely serve as the emergency No. 3 quarterback if Trevor Lawrence and Quinn Ewers both go down in Sunday's game against the Browns. Mullens will be eligible for only two more practice squad elevations this regular season, so this is not a role the quarterback can fill perpetually.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Signs with practice squad
metadata.description: The Jaguars signed Mullens to the practice squad Monday.
metadata.analysis: The Jaguars released Mullens during Sunday's cutdown day. The quarterback participated in all three preseason games for the team, completing 14 of his 21 pass attempts for 160 yards and an interception. Mullens may be elevated for a contest if Trevor Lawrence or Quinn Ewers must miss time due to injury.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens released by Jaguars
metadata.description: The Jaguars released QB Nick Mullens.
metadata.analysis: Mullens loses his roster spot after Jacksonville traded for Quinn Ewers from Miami.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Let go by Jaguars
metadata.description: Jacksonville cut Mullens on Sunday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Mullens appeared set to work as Trevor Lawrence's backup this season, but that changed when the Jaguars traded with Miami for Quinn Ewers on Saturday. Mullens has extensive NFL experience -- including 20 career regular-season starts -- so he could be an attractive option for another team looking to fill out its QB room with a veteran signal-caller.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Sharp in Friday's start
metadata.description: Mullens completed six of seven passes for 65 yards in Friday's 34-17 preseason loss to the Panthers.
metadata.analysis: The Jaguars rested their starters in this one, so Mullens was under center for the first quarter and led the offense on one field-goal drive in two possessions before turning things over to Carter Bradley. Mullens figures to be the No. 2 quarterback this year behind Trevor Lawrence, a role that may not require him to see much action -- Lawrence has played all 17 regular-season games in three of his five NFL seasons.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Back to practice
metadata.description: Mullens (undisclosed) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Jamal St. Cyr of News4JAX reports.
metadata.analysis: Mullens participated in 11-on-11 drills during Tuesday's session. The veteran quarterback went 3-for-7 for 33 yards and an interception in last Saturday's preseason opener against the Saints. Mullens' health means he is likely available to check into Friday's contest against the Panthers once Trevor Lawrence's potential snaps are done. After last Saturday's performance, however, coach Liam Cohen might decide to give Carter Bradley or Joey Aguilar the bulk of the second-team snaps.

metadata.title: Nick Mullens - Status in question this week
metadata.description: Mullens (undisclosed) is unlikely to return to practice this week, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Coach Liam Coen provided the update on Mullens on Monday, and now it appears that the vet may not be available for the Jaguars' second preseason game Friday against the Panthers. Mullens went 3-for-7 for 33 yards and an interception in the preseason opener against the Saints. A Mullens absence would open more reps for Carter Bradley and Joey Aguilar.
